meta.title: Education ERP
meta.description: One configurable education management platform for schools, colleges, universities, madrasas, coaching centers and training institutes.

home.heading: Education ERP
home.tagline: One configurable platform for schools, colleges, universities, madrasas, coaching centers and training institutes.
home.status: Platform foundation and sign-in are available. Business modules arrive in later phases.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email address and password of your account.
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address. If it belongs to an active account, we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If the address belongs to an active account, a reset link is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: You'll be signed out on every device.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.intro: Choose the password you'll use to sign in.
activate.done: Your account is active. You can now sign in.

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
mfaSetup.intro: Your account needs a second sign-in step. Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 2FAS.
mfaSetup.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfaSetup.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfaSetup.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter the key manually
mfaSetup.manualWarning: Type this key into your authenticator app now. It is shown only once and can't be shown again.
mfaSetup.clipboardWarning: If you copied the key, clear your clipboard after adding it to the app.
mfaSetup.keyGone: The key was already shown. If you didn't save it, restart setup to get a new key.
mfaSetup.expiresNote: For your security, this setup expires after 10 minutes.
mfaSetup.recoveryIntro: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They are shown only now: store them somewhere safe.
mfaSetup.ack: I have saved my recovery codes in a safe place.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: This action is sensitive. Re-enter your password (and authenticator code) to continue for the next 10 minutes.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: For your security you'll be signed out in about {minutes} minutes because of inactivity.

validation.passwordNumeric: The password can't be only numbers.
validation.recoveryFormat: Enter a recovery code like ABCD-EFGH-IJKL-MNOP.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_mfa_code: That code didn't work. Try the current code.
errors.mfa_challenge_expired: The sign-in attempt expired. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.step_up_required: Please confirm it's you to continue.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.manual_key_already_shown: The setup key can be shown only once. Restart setup to get a new key.
errors.mfa_required: This needs a session verified with two-factor authentication. Sign in again.
errors.mfa_required_for_account: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for your account.
errors.last_super_admin: The last active Super Admin can't be removed or deactivated.
errors.privilege_escalation: You can't grant permissions you don't hold.
errors.role_in_use: Revoke this role from all users first.
errors.cannot_deactivate_self: You can't deactivate your own account.
errors.mfa_locked: Too many incorrect codes. Two-factor verification is locked for {seconds} seconds.
errors.insufficient_privilege: You can't do this to an account with more privileges than yours.
errors.cannot_reset_own_mfa: Reset your own two-factor authentication from your account security page.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invitation is not valid any more. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.limit_exceeded: Your organisation has reached its limit. Contact the platform team to raise it.
errors.last_tenant_owner: The organisation must keep at least one active owner.
errors.cannot_act_on_self: You can't do this to your own membership.
errors.tenant_hosts_disabled: Organisations can't be created while organisation addresses are disabled.
errors.not_a_member: You are not a member of this organisation.
errors.support_access_read_only: Support access can only read data.
errors.tenant_unavailable: This organisation no longer accepts changes.
errors.module_not_entitled: Your organisation's plan doesn't include this module.

dashboard.title: Welcome, {name}
dashboard.subtitle: Choose where to go next.
dashboard.security: Password, two-factor authentication and active sessions.
dashboard.users: Create platform users and manage their access.
dashboard.roles: Platform roles, role templates and the permission catalog.
dashboard.tenantRoles: Roles of this organisation; clone one to customise it.
dashboard.supportAccess: Requests from platform support and their history.
dashboard.myInstitutions: Organisations you belong to and where to sign in.
dashboard.tenants: Provision organisations, suspend them and set their limits.
dashboard.supportSessions: Request read-only support access to an organisation.
dashboard.studio: Terminology, custom fields, forms, rules, workflows, templates and numbering.

account.title: Account security
account.subtitle: Manage how you sign in and where you're signed in.
account.passwordHint: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
account.emailHint: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address.
account.emailSent: Check the new address for a confirmation link.
account.mfaOff: Off. Add a second step to protect your account.
account.sessionsHint: Sign out of devices you don't recognise. IP addresses are partly hidden.

users.title: Platform users
users.subtitle: Accounts are created by administrators; users activate them by email.
users.createHint: We'll email an activation link. The account can't sign in until it is activated.
users.deactivatedDone: The user was deactivated and signed out.
users.reasonHint: Required, e.g. a support ticket reference. It is recorded in the audit log.
users.mfaResetDone: MFA was reset; the user was signed out and notified.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Roles are bundles of permissions. Access is always checked by permission, never by role name.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only record of security events. IP addresses are masked; revealing one is itself audited.

banner.youAreSupport: You are using read-only support access until {until}.
banner.supportActive: Platform support has read-only access until {until}.

mine.title: My organisations
mine.subtitle: Each organisation has its own address and its own sign-in.
mine.empty: You are not a member of any organisation yet.
mine.hostsDisabled: Sign-in links appear when organisation addresses are enabled.

tenancy.reasonHint: 10 to 200 characters. It is recorded in the audit log.
tenancy.slugHint: 3–32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter. It becomes the address and can't change.
tenancy.currencyHint: Three-letter currency code, e.g. BDT or USD.
tenancy.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
tenancy.ownerEmailHint: The owner gets an invitation to set a password and two-factor authentication.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.subtitle: Registry of customer organisations. Their data is never shown here.
tenants.provisionHint: Creates the organisation, its first institution and main campus, and invites the owner.
tenants.suspendHint: Members lose access at once; only owners can still sign in to review support access. Open support sessions are revoked.
tenants.overrideHint: Overrides the plan limits for this organisation. Lowering a limit only blocks new creations.

support.ownSubtitle: Read-only, time-limited access to one organisation, normally approved by its owners.
support.title: Support access
support.subtitle: Platform support can read this organisation's data only through a session you approve. It is read-only, time-limited and audited.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.subtitle: Institutions you can see in this organisation.
institutions.limitHint: The number of institutions is limited by your plan.
institutions.archiveHint: The institution and its campuses are archived. Nothing is deleted.

campuses.title: Campuses
campuses.limitHint: The number of campuses is limited by your plan.
campuses.name: Campus name

members.inviteHint: They get an email link to join with this role.
members.title: Members
members.subtitle: People in your scopes, their status and open invitations.
members.removeHint: Their roles end and they are signed out here. The history is kept.
members.grantHint: You can only give roles whose permissions you hold where you give them.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: System roles stay in line with the platform templates and can't be edited. Clone one to customise it.
roles.cloneHint: The copy is an editable role of this organisation.
roles.name: Role name
roles.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores; starts with a letter.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organisation profile and support access.
settings.approvalOn: Platform support needs an owner's approval before reading data (recommended).
settings.approvalOff: Support requests are approved automatically. They stay time-limited, visible and revocable.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change this, with a reason.

audit.subtitle: Security events of this organisation. IP addresses are masked; revealing one is audited.

accept.title: Join {name}
accept.intro: Enter the password of your account, or choose one to create your account.
accept.createdDone: Your account is ready and you have joined. Sign in to continue.
accept.joinedDone: You have joined. Sign in to continue.
accept.passwordHint: New account: at least {min} characters. Existing account: your current password.

billing.name: Name
billing.trialLengthHint: Leave empty for no automatic trial

tenant.title: Subscription
tenant.subtitle: Your organisation's plan, modules and limits.
tenant.planHint: Contact the platform team to change your plan.
tenant.limitsHint: New institutions or campuses can't be added beyond these limits.
tenant.modulesHint: Screens of modules your plan doesn't include are hidden and refused.

platform.title: Plans and pricing
platform.subtitle: Plans, add-ons and prices. Prices are entered by the owner and are never edited, only replaced.
platform.pricesHint: A new price replaces the active one for the same plan, currency and interval.
platform.addPriceHint: Enter the amount exactly as approved by the owner.
platform.deactivateHint: The price stays in the history but can no longer be used.
platform.subscriptionHint: Every change needs a reason and is recorded in both audit logs.
platform.assignPlanHint: The organisation moves to this plan now; a running trial ends.
platform.startTrialHint: The organisation uses this plan until the trial ends.
platform.addAddonHint: The add-on's module is included from now on.
platform.setOverrideHint: Grant or revoke one module for this organisation only.

studio.title: Customization Studio
studio.subtitle: Configure your organisation without code. Drafts change nothing until you publish them.
studio.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _; it cannot change later.
studio.name: Name

hints.rules: namespace, rule (allow-listed operators only) and test_cases. A rule is published only when every test passes.
hints.forms: entity and layout: sections with core or custom fields and an optional visible_when rule.
hints.workflows: subject and spec: states, initial, transitions with permissions, optional guards and sla_hours.
hints.templates: kind and content per locale (subject and body). Only the documented variables are available.

settings.title: Organisation settings
settings.draftOpen: A draft is open. Publish it to apply the changes.
settings.noDraft: No draft: you are viewing the published settings.
settings.terminologyHint: Rename terms in the interface, e.g. Class → Grade.
settings.label: Label

fields.addHint: The key and type cannot change after the field is created.

form.failed: The form could not be checked. Try again.

steps.fields: Add the custom fields you need

signup.title: Create your organisation
signup.intro: Tell us about your institution. We confirm your email, review the request and then invite you as the owner.
signup.closed: Self-service sign-up is not open. Contact us to get started.
signup.slugHint: 3-32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes your organisation's address.
signup.currencyHint: Three-letter code, for example BDT or USD.
signup.emailHint: You will be the owner. We send the confirmation link here.
signup.approvalNote: Every request is reviewed by our team before the organisation is created.
signup.sent: Thank you. If the details are valid, a confirmation email is on its way. The link works for 48 hours.
signup.verifyIntro: Confirm that you asked to create this organisation.
signup.verified: Confirmed. Our team now reviews your request; you receive an invitation by email when it is approved.

admin.title: Sign-up requests
admin.subtitle: Approve verified requests to create the organisation and invite its owner, or reject them with a reason.
admin.reasonHint: 10 to 200 characters; kept with the request.

academics.title: Academic structure
academics.subtitle: Academic years, the institution's structure and its subjects.
academics.name: Name

subjects.title: Subjects and courses
subjects.creditsHint: Credits apply to credit-based institutions; leave empty otherwise.

units.title: Structure
units.levelsHint: The levels and their names come from the institution's preset and Studio terminology.
units.noPreset: This institution has no structure levels yet. Choose a preset in its settings.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.subtitle: Admission cycles, applications, tests, merit lists and inquiries.
admissions.noAccess: You can't see this for the chosen institution.

cycles.title: Admission cycles
cycles.noTargets: No targets yet — add at least one before opening.
cycles.bindingsHint: Use the keys of published Studio items: the application form is required; the workflow, merit rule and numbering sequence are optional.

applications.decideHint: An offer needs a free seat in the target.
applications.inWorkflow: Reviewed through the workflow (see Studio requests).

merit.byScore: Ranked by the total test score.
merit.failed: The ranking can't be computed (check the merit rule).

inquiries.contactHint: A phone number or an email address is needed.
inquiries.name: Name

entry.hint: For an applicant who applies in person or by phone. The cycle's form is checked by the server.

apply.title: Apply for admission
apply.closed: Online applications are not available here.
apply.noneOpen: No admission is open right now.
apply.sent: Thank you. If the details are valid, we have emailed you a link to confirm the application. It expires in 48 hours.
apply.limited: Too many attempts from this network. Please try again later.
apply.privacy: Your details are used only for this admission and are visible only to the institution's admission staff.
apply.verifyIntro: Press the button to submit your application.
apply.verified: Your application is submitted. We have emailed you a personal link to follow it.
apply.offerIntro: You have been offered a seat. Please answer:
apply.documentHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 5 MB each, at most 5 files.
apply.tooLarge: This file is larger than 5 MB.
apply.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: The students you may see: your scope, the ones you teach or advise, your children, yourself.
students.numberHint: Leave the number empty to take the next one from the 'student' numbering sequence.
students.notFound: This student doesn't exist or isn't visible to you.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.matchHint: An existing guardian with the same phone or email is linked instead of a new one.

actions.title: Actions and documents
actions.tcHint: The student leaves; the number comes from the 'transfer_certificate' sequence unless you give one.

import.title: Import
import.subtitle: Bulk import of students or staff from a CSV or Excel file: a dry run first, then apply.
import.file: File (CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB)
import.ready: The file is checked. Map its columns.

promotion.title: Promotion
promotion.subtitle: Move the students of a unit to the next year: preview, adjust, then apply.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Staff profiles, departments, designations and class teachers.
staff.numberHint: Leave the number empty to take the next one from the 'staff' numbering sequence. A login is optional.

advisors.title: Class teachers
advisors.hint: Class teachers see the students of the unit (and the units below it) for that year.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.subtitle: Weekly lessons by unit, and your own lessons.

lesson.hint: A clash (the same unit, teacher or room at that time) is refused.

timetable.name: Name

portal.title: My children
portal.subtitle: Your children's class and timetable.
portal.none: No child is linked to your account yet. Ask the institution to invite you.
portal.comingSoon: Attendance, results, fees and notices will appear here as they arrive.
